topic: the pain of paying -- why cards make people spend more than cash
title: The Real Reason Your Card Makes You Spend More Than Cash
description: AI-narrated commentary on the psychology behind why paying by card makes people spend more than cash -- based on a real MIT auction study on the 'pain of paying'. #shorts #psychology #money

hook_candidates.text: Card shoppers bid twice as much as cash shoppers for the same item.
Why does paying with a card make you spend more than paying with cash for the exact same thing?
Cash and card don't feel the same to your brain -- cash pays through real pain, a card skips it.
MIT ran a live auction where half the room paid cash and half paid card -- the card bids came in nearly double.

beats.text: Card shoppers bid **twice** as much as cash shoppers for the same item.
MIT tested it live -- half the room paid cash, half paid card.
Cash physically hurts your brain a little to hand over. Cards **skip** that pain.
No pain, no hesitation -- that's why the bids **doubled**. Follow for the next one.
